title: Attenuation of LPS-induced inflammatory responses in J774A.1 macrophages by phenylpropanoids and ursane triterpenes from Lavandula coronopifolia Poir.
task: Identify anti-inflammatory phytochemicals from Lavandula coronopifolia and characterize their effects in LPS-stimulated macrophages
key_results: Compounds 2, 3, and 6 significantly reduced cell migration, downregulated iNOS and IL-6 expression, and altered cell morphology similar to dexamethasone; compound 5 showed selective cytotoxicity to A549 cells (EC50=11.5 µM) with no effect on HEK293T
comments: The study identifies promising leads for anti-inflammatory therapy but lacks mechanistic depth regarding signaling pathway inhibition.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phenylpropanoids and ursane triterpenes attenuate LPS-induced inflammatory responses
hypotheses.result: Compounds 2, 3, and 6 reduced cell migration and downregulated iNOS/IL-6 expression in J774A.1 cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Compound 5 exhibits selective anticancer activity
hypotheses.result: Selective cytotoxicity against A549 with EC50=11.5 µM; no toxicity to HEK293T cells

title: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation is associated with improved functional recovery and time-dependent changes in apoptosis-related execution-phase markers after spinal cord injury
task: Determine whether rTMS reduces apoptosis and improves motor recovery after spinal cord injury in time-dependent manner
key_results: rTMS reduced apoptosis-related signaling (caspase-3/7, PARP1 cleavage) and improved tissue preservation and motor recovery at later time points post-SCI; limited early effects
comments: The time-dependent analysis is methodologically strong, though the mechanistic link between transcranial stimulation and apoptosis reduction remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: rTMS reduces activation of execution-phase apoptosis signaling after SCI
hypotheses.result: Time-dependent reduction in caspase-3, cleaved caspase-3, caspase-7, and cleaved PARP1 at later time points

hypotheses.hypothesis: Apoptotic signaling is localized to neurons
hypotheses.result: Double immunofluorescence confirmed co-localization of NeuN and cleaved caspase-3

title: Engineered Ti₃C₂ MXene nanosystems for macrophage-targeted therapy of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis
task: Engineer nanozymes to suppress inflammation and ROS in hepatic macrophages for MASH treatment
key_results: MMCT reduced intracellular ROS, enhanced SOD activity, promoted M1-to-M2 macrophage repolarization, and mitigated lobular inflammation and steatosis in murine MASH model
comments: The mannose-targeting strategy is elegant for macrophage selectivity, though in vivo efficacy comparison with non-targeted controls would strengthen the claim.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mannose-modified MMCT selectively targets hepatic macrophages via receptor-mediated endocytosis
hypotheses.result: MMCT achieved precise localization to hepatic lesions and amplified antioxidant efficacy

hypotheses.hypothesis: ROS scavenging and TLR4/NF-κB inhibition promote M1-to-M2 repolarization
hypotheses.result: Downregulation of pro-inflammatory mediators and suppressed lipid droplet accumulation observed

title: A metaheuristic automated framework for quality improvement of CT imagery
task: Automated clip-limit selection for CT image contrast enhancement
key_results: WOA-PIQE-CLAHE framework achieved PIQE of 29.81±1.14 and contrast of 71.54±1.04 versus baseline PIQE of 32.02±0.99 and contrast of 69.31±1.05 on 315 CT slices
comments: The improvement is modest and single-metric optimization (PIQE) may not capture all aspects of clinically relevant image quality.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Automated whale-algorithm-driven CL selection improves CT contrast without degrading perceptual quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: lower PIQE and higher contrast achieved simultaneously

title: Machine learning-based prediction of 3-month mortality in elderly patients with non-small cell lung cancer and bone metastases
task: Develop and validate machine learning models for 3-month cancer-specific mortality prediction in elderly NSCLC patients with bone metastases
key_results: Logistic regression achieved AUC of 0.79 on validation set and accuracy of 0.78±0.02 across 10-fold cross-validation; overall 3-month mortality rate 48.5%; key predictors include absent chemotherapy, liver/brain metastases, and shorter diagnosis-to-treatment time
comments: Logistic regression outperformed more complex models, suggesting good feature engineering; internal validation only—external validation critical before clinical deployment.

model_io.model: Seven machine learning algorithms (logistic regression, and six others) compared

hypotheses.hypothesis: Machine learning can accurately predict 3-month mortality in elderly NSCLC patients with bone metastases
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: logistic regression achieved AUC 0.79 with clinically useful net benefit

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chemotherapy status and secondary metastases are strong mortality predictors in this population
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: absence of chemotherapy and presence of liver/brain metastases identified as key influential predictors

title: Serum proteomic signatures and an immune-calcium signaling cascade associated with antipsychotic-related erectile dysfunction in schizophrenia
task: Identify serum proteomic signatures and molecular pathways associated with antipsychotic-related erectile dysfunction
key_results: 473 differentially expressed proteins identified; 10 hub proteins including RYR3, PRKCA, KRT18; enrichment in immune, inflammatory, and calcium signaling pathways
comments: The immune-calcium signaling cascade hypothesis is intriguing but requires mechanistic validation; peripheral proteomic changes may reflect rather than drive the phenotype.

model_io.model: Label-free quantitative proteomics with network analysis
inputs: serum samples from APRED and non-APRED male schizophrenia patients (n=66)

hypotheses.hypothesis: APRED is associated with distinct serum proteomic signature involving immune and calcium signaling disruption
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 473 DEPs identified with PPI analysis implicating RYR3-centered calcium signaling and immune pathways

hypotheses.hypothesis: APRED reflects a schizophrenia-related biological subtype with peripheral immune-calcium axis vulnerability
hypotheses.result: Supported by proteomic data and pathway enrichment; causality not established

title: FL-trafficNet: a hybrid federated transformer-GNN framework with dual attention for smart routing in IoV and VANET environments
task: Federated hybrid Transformer-GNN routing framework for IoV/VANET traffic management
key_results: FL-TrafficNet achieved MAE=1.95, RMSE=2.87, MAPE=3.12; privacy score 97.8%, traffic delivery rate 38.4%
comments: Dual-attention Transformer+GNN + federated learning for privacy-aware routing is well-designed; reinforcement component for dynamic decisions adds robustness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Federated Transformer-GNN with dual attention and reinforcement learning improves prediction accuracy and privacy while enabling real-time adaptive routing
hypotheses.result: Superior traffic prediction and delivery metrics vs recent methods; 97.8% privacy score validates federated approach

title: Federated multi-cloud task scheduling with load balancing using multi-objective NSGA-II and reinforcement learning
task: Multi-objective task scheduling in federated multi-cloud environments
key_results: Makespan reduced by 18–32%, resource utilization improved by 10–22%
comments: Hybrid NSGA-II+Q-learning approach is sound but evaluation limited to simulation; real federated deployments would strengthen claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrating NSGA-II with Q-learning improves adaptation to inter-cloud heterogeneity
hypotheses.result: Framework achieved better load balance and cost/makespan trade-offs vs baselines

title: Geometry-aware localization evaluation of grad-CAM for wafer map defect classification
task: Evaluating explainability and localization accuracy of Grad-CAM for wafer defect classification
key_results: Radial suppression method improved Top-10% IoU by 19.4% (0.129→0.155); oracle upper bound at 0.278 IoU
comments: Identification of systematic radial bias in gradient-based attribution is valuable; findings suggest geometric model properties drive residual localization errors.

inputs: wafer map images (WM811K dataset, N=3828 test)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Radial attribution bias reflects learned model representations rather than gradient-weighting artifacts
hypotheses.result: Consistent bias profiles observed across Grad-CAM and XGrad-CAM; suppression method confirmed geometric bias origin

title: Task-oriented visual SLAM: a comprehensive map classification framework for dynamic indoor robot manipulation
task: Taxonomy and systematic evaluation of visual SLAM map representations for robotic mobile manipulation
key_results: Framework identifies four complementary map categories; evaluates trade-offs in environmental adaptability, pose estimation accuracy, and real-time feasibility
comments: Comprehensive survey with actionable taxonomy; lacks quantitative benchmarking on standardized mobile manipulation tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid vSLAM maps coupling mapping semantics with manipulation affordances improve downstream task performance
hypotheses.result: Conceptual framework proposed; quantitative validation deferred to future work

title: Exact wave structures in magneto-optic soliton channels governed by Kudryashov-type coupled Schrödinger dynamics
task: Exact soliton solutions in magneto-optic waveguides via improved simple equation method
key_results: New spectrum of analytical solutions including robust kink, antikink, singular profiles with parametric characterization; tunable pulse stability and transition gradients
comments: Theoretical framework for coupled Kudryashov-type NLSE under magnetization is rigorous; practical optical device implications require experimental validation.

inputs: generalized coupled Kudryashov NLSE with higher-order nonlinear effects
outputs: exact analytical soliton solutions (kink, antikink, singular)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tuning nonlinear coefficients in magneto-optic waveguides enables precise control over pulse stability and transition gradients
hypotheses.result: New parametric solution family derived; insights support high-capacity optical communication and all-optical switching design

title: Optimized routing with Ant Colony Algorithms to extend network lifetime in Wireless Sensor Networks
task: Energy-efficient routing in wireless sensor networks
key_results: Energy consumption reduced 18–25%, packet delivery ratio improved 6–10%
comments: LTAWSN adds spatial awareness to ACO routing; modest improvements suggest saturation in this problem domain.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Incorporating spatial proximity and dual energy metrics improves routing efficiency
hypotheses.result: Outperformed ACLR, ACA, EAACA on energy and PDR across different node densities

title: Robust and intelligent control strategies for a 3-DOF robotic arm: a comparative study
task: Comparative control strategy evaluation for 3-DOF robotic arm trajectory tracking
key_results: SMC achieves ~80% RMSE reduction vs PID, ~50% improvement over FLC; peak Cartesian position errors <0.005 m vs PID 0.11 m
comments: Comprehensive dynamic modeling and systematic benchmarking under identical conditions; SMC's superior robustness and disturbance rejection well-demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nonlinear robust control (SMC) outperforms linear (PID) and soft-computing (FLC) strategies for highly coupled, nonlinear 3-DOF manipulators
hypotheses.result: SMC maintained consistency across all joints; superior convergence speed and disturbance rejection confirmed via RMSE/ITAE/IAE metrics

title: Robust graph-transformer soft sensor for radar level estimation in dynamic LPG storage systems
task: Robust soft sensor for radar-based liquid-level monitoring in dynamic LPG storage
key_results: RGTNs achieved R²=0.9704, MAE=151.12 mm, RMSE=198.33 mm; outperforms existing models on LPG carrier data
comments: Graph-Transformer fusion for spatiotemporal dependencies is sound; real-world LPG data validation strengthens industrial relevance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph attention + Transformer for spatiotemporal fusion and learned sensor fusion improves level estimation under dynamic conditions
hypotheses.result: Superior performance vs baselines; physically interpretable attention mechanisms provide reliability for safety-critical LPG monitoring

title: A hierarchical neuromorphic multi agent framework for energy aware and secure 6G resource optimization using Neuro6G agent
task: Neuromorphic multi-agent framework for energy-aware 6G resource optimization
key_results: Neuro6G-Agent achieved 34.7% energy reduction, 28.3% latency decrease, 95.6% threat detection accuracy vs baselines (p<0.01)
comments: Spiking neural networks + MARL for hierarchical 6G optimization is innovative; multi-benchmark validation strengthens generalization claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical neuromorphic agents with adaptive thresholds and distributed trust enable energy-efficient, secure 6G resource management
hypotheses.result: Across three benchmarks, achieved substantial energy/latency/security improvements; statistical significance confirmed

title: WHiAR-Net: an interpretable multi-scale forecasting framework via Wavelet-Hilbert feature engineering
task: Interpretable time-series forecasting using wavelet-Hilbert feature engineering
key_results: WHiAR-Net achieves competitive accuracy on electricity/environmental datasets; outperforms deep learning baselines with interpretability
comments: Wavelet+Hilbert decomposition for trend/transient separation is well-motivated; limited quantitative comparison metrics provided.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structural embedding of operator error bounds via wavelet-Hilbert analysis yields interpretable forecasting with accuracy competitive to black-box models
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated on energy grid and climate datasets; transparent architecture supports knowledge extraction

title: Improved Pied Kingfisher Optimization Algorithm for optimal scheduling of microgrids with hybrid energy storage
task: Optimal microgrid scheduling with hybrid energy storage using metaheuristic optimization
key_results: IPKO reduces mean daily operating cost by 4–10% vs representative metaheuristics with lower solution dispersion
comments: Four enhancement strategies (Chebyshev chaos, multi-source guidance, spiral development, dynamic adjustment) are well-motivated; modest improvements suggest diminishing returns in metaheuristic design.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Enhanced PSO-variant with adaptive diversity and convergence mechanisms outperforms standard metaheuristics for nonconvex microgrid scheduling
hypotheses.result: IPKO consistently achieved 4–10% cost reduction with reduced solution variance across independent runs

title: A federated blockchain framework for secure and intelligent smart farming in sustainable industrial agriculture
task: Privacy-preserving federated blockchain framework for smart farming
key_results: Model accuracy 92.4%, throughput 2350 TPS, latency 1.0 s; privacy leakage and energy cost reduced 73% and 45%
comments: AgriChain-FL demonstrates practical integration of FL and blockchain; scalability claims need validation on larger heterogeneous farm networks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid PBFT-PoA consensus is more scalable and energy-efficient than standard PoW
hypotheses.result: Achieved 2350 TPS, 1.0 s block latency, 45% energy cost reduction vs analogous frameworks

title: A flow field reconstruction based on cylindrical wake flow data using the PSO-CNN-LSTM algorithm
task: Spatiotemporal reconstruction of unsteady cylindrical wake flow using PSO-CNN-LSTM
key_results: Streamwise velocity error ~10⁻³, cross-stream velocity error ~10⁻²; outperforms LSTM/RNN/Transformer baselines in rolling prediction
comments: Well-motivated hybrid architecture with uncertainty quantification via MC dropout; cross-stream reconstruction remains challenging due to phase-dependence.

inputs: velocity field snapshots (2D incompressible cylindrical wake)

hypotheses.hypothesis: CNN-LSTM with PSO hyperparameter optimization and MC dropout achieves reliable spatiotemporal reconstruction under missing-frame conditions
hypotheses.result: Superior accuracy vs baselines; positive error–uncertainty correlation validates trustworthiness for engineering applications

title: Biologically inspired optimization of construction sector eco industrial park networks using food web metrics
task: Optimization of eco-industrial park networks using food web biometrics and genetic algorithms
key_results: Scenario-constrained GA optimization demonstrates trade-offs across network morphology metrics; connectance as design parameter reduces extreme connectivity regimes
comments: Biomimetic approach to EIP design is innovative; findings show configuration-dependent proximity to food-web benchmarks with persistent deficits in link density/cyclicity.

model_io.model: Genetic Algorithm with scenario-constrained multi-metric optimization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bio-inspired network optimization targeting food-web structural metrics with reciprocal participation rules yields more benchmark-consistent EIP topologies
hypotheses.result: Reciprocal policies produced more balanced metric profiles under certain objective formulations; connectance limiting extreme connectivity

title: Flashover prediction of polluted composite insulators based on arc time constant and velocity using CNN–LSTM
task: Flashover prediction in polluted composite insulators via arc dynamics and CNN-LSTM
key_results: CNN-LSTM achieves superior performance in arc velocity prediction with real-time adaptation using leakage current data
comments: Unified arc model bridging analytical theory with transient dynamics is novel; statistical validation of error distributions adds rigor.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic coupling of arc time constant with velocity via CNN-LSTM feature extraction captures transient arc propagation better than static models
hypotheses.result: Model transitions smoothly between discharge stages with real-time LC adaptation; superior performance vs benchmarks

title: Enabling geometry and toolpath generalization for machine learning based thermal modeling in laser powder bed fusion
task: Generalization of neural surrogate models for thermal prediction in laser powder bed fusion
key_results: ~1000× speedup vs FEM while maintaining high accuracy; U-Net CNN generalizes to unseen geometries and toolpaths
comments: Clever use of signed distance fields and time-gradient fields enables geometry/toolpath generalization; validates practical applicability for manufacturing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Feature engineering with geometric and temporal operators enables single model to generalize across different part shapes and toolpath orientations
hypotheses.result: Achieved 1000× computational speedup with maintained accuracy; unlocks real-time thermal optimization

title: Uniaxial structural flexibility of an anisotropic Br adlayer structure on Au(100) electrodes revealed by video-rate STM
task: Characterizing lateral deformability and dynamics of Br adlayer on Au(100) electrodes
key_results: Video-rate STM reveals uniaxial structural distortions via antiphase row shifting along [010]
DFT calculations show low diffusion barriers enabling rapid one-dimensional vacancy diffusion
comments: Real-time observation of adsorbate layer dynamics is experimentally challenging but crucial for understanding electrochemical interfaces; the connection between structural anisotropy and dynamic flexibility is well-demonstrated.

outputs: Real-time images of adsorbate row motion

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structural anisotropy permits uniaxial rather than isotropic deformation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: antiphase shifting occurs selectively along [010] direction

hypotheses.hypothesis: One-dimensional fractional vacancy diffusion explains observed dynamics
hypotheses.result: Supported by low DFT-calculated diffusion barriers
